explanation: Wright meant visitors to ride a lift to the top and stroll down the gentle spiral. The museum opened in October 1959, six months after he died.

claims.text: Frank Lloyd Wright's Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum in New York displays art along a continuous spiral ramp.
The Guggenheim's galleries are not arranged along a moving walkway, a stack of cubes or a sunken courtyard.
Wright intended visitors to take a lift to the top and walk down the ramp.
The Guggenheim Museum in New York opened in October 1959.
Frank Lloyd Wright died in April 1959, six months before the museum opened.
